Name: RetainIQ
Tagline: Know which customers need attention, why & what to do next
Description: RetainIQ shows B2B SaaS teams which customers need attention, why, and what to do next, ranked by revenue at risk. Every recommendation comes with the evidence behind it, so your team can act with confidence. Recover prioritizes failed payments. Retain shows churn evidence and confidence. Reactivate finds dormant customers worth contacting. Start free for 15 days, no credit card.

Name: Tano
Tagline: Korean vocabulary app that skips the words you know
Description: Tano is an iPhone app for learning Korean vocabulary. A short level check skips the words you already know. Then you get a few new words a day, each with an example sentence and sound, and reviews tomorrow, in 3 days and in a week. Words come sorted into 20 real-life situations and 53 topics. Practice by choosing the meaning, filling in the sentence or writing in Hangul, while your avatar grows from 아기 to 어른. Free to start, no account needed.

Name: overads.io
Tagline: Marketing and GTM that run while you sleep
Description: overads runs marketing and GTM for founders, end to end. Describe a job once and it becomes a workflow that runs every week. It writes, designs and schedules posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. It watches your Meta and Google ads, and you can pause a campaign or move a budget right from chat. GTMgenie runs your outbound on email and LinkedIn. Nothing goes out without your yes. One plan, $59/month.

Name: Superrelay
Tagline: One inbox for every app you ship, never priced per ticket
Description: One support workspace for teams shipping several apps: chat, email, WhatsApp, Slack and in-app in one inbox. An AI agent that cites sources and asks before acting, GitHub-synced docs, and a CLI/MCP so coding agents read tickets. Never priced per ticket.

Name: GrayPass
Tagline: Verify who’s in control before agents make sensitive actions
Description: Login tools tell you who signed in. GrayPass verifies who’s still in control when it actually matters. Before a wire, payout change, admin grant, or other sensitive action executes, GrayPass uses behavioral and session evidence to decide whether to allow, re-verify, hold, or deny it. Its Brainprint learns how each person types, moves, and scrolls without capturing what they type, adding fresh assurance without forcing MFA on every user.

Name: airoom
Tagline: An open-source control room for your Claude Code agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Every project is a room and every Claude Code session is a desk. See who is working, who is waiting on you and who is stuck. Chat, approve commands, hire a team, or let an agent test your app in the built-in browser. Free, local and open source.

Name: Dex Telemetry
Tagline: Open-source Datadog for analytics
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Data & Analytics
Description: You set up analytics to monitor your business. But who's monitoring your analytics? Dex Telemetry gives you observability for your pipelines, with rules and context built for your agents.

Name: Slopie
Tagline: A free 3D map of every ski resort, in your browser
Description: Slopie shows more than 4,000 ski resorts in 69 countries in 3D, with every run and lift on the real terrain. The whole map is free in any browser, with no account. The iPhone and Apple Watch app records your ski days on the same map.

Name: Cognition SWE-2.1
Tagline: A long-horizon coding model with a 10x faster Ultrafast mode
Description: SWE-2.1 is Cognition's upgraded coding model, trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 for long-horizon work. Per Cognition, FrontierCode 2.0 rose from 24.1 to 41.3, Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 24.2 to 50.0 and ExploitBench from 36.1 to 80.0. SWE-2.1 Ultrafast runs about 10x faster with Cerebras. Available in Devin Desktop, Cloud and CLI, free through December 8 on Desktop and CLI.

Name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
Tagline: Microsoft's decision model: calibrated, 2x faster, now GA
Description: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is a decision model, trained to make reliable choices inside software instead of writing text. It picks from permitted actions, reports confidence so apps can defer when unsure, and now accepts images. Per Microsoft, it is over 2x faster than v1 at about the same cost, and scores 68 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. Generally available on Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel after a public preview last month.

Name: ro
Tagline: I won't bother you
Description: ro sits quietly on your Mac desktop or menu bar and stays out of your way. Free as a desktop pet that reacts to your apps. Unlock Pro for local file search (⌥R), Downloads cleanup with undo, and private AI handoff. Nothing leaves your Mac.

Name: DearDarling
Tagline: A couples messenger with a mutual friend, Pip
Description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. A private messenger for two, with Pip: a mutual friend who knows your chat, gives one tip when you ask, and talks to each of you alone without taking sides. Every night, your day becomes a page.

Name: Stacktrace
Tagline: Real-time steering and guardrails for AI agents
Description: Stacktrace is a control layer for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin. It reads their tool calls, blocks unsafe ones before they run, enforces the limits your team sets and steps in when an agent drifts from its intent.

Name: Bento
Tagline: Runnable lessons and interactive maps of GitHub repos
Topics: Open Source, Education, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Bento is a free, open-source Mac app for learning how software works. Get runnable lessons from questions or take apart GitHub repos. It uses the AI subscription you already have. Try ready-made lessons and featured repos in your browser, no install.

Name: gutcheck
Tagline: Check your gut against the internet, inside Claude Code
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Before you build it, find out if anyone wants it. Type /gutcheck and an idea, a problem or a decision in Claude Code. It plans a study, pulls live evidence from Google Trends, Google News, Hacker News, GitHub, the App Store, Wikipedia and the web, and gives you a verdict: how sure it is, the case against, and what to do this week. No API keys to start. Runs on your machine. Free and open source.

Name: OpenCrawl
Tagline: Multiplayer for your coding agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other's histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more. Open source, self-hostable and free to start.

Name: Tallhorn
Tagline: A native MongoDB® client where AI agents ask before writing
Description: Tallhorn is a fast, native MongoDB® client for Mac, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. Browse documents as a table, tree or JSON, script queries in JavaScript, build pipelines stage by stage, read explain plans, and turn queries into dashboards. A built-in MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code query your databases under rules you set per connection, and by default every agent write waits for your approval. No account, no analytics. Free; Pro adds dashboards and agents, $29.99 once.

Name: NOVA
Tagline: Development to deployment, and everything after.
Description: Building is the easy part. NOVA handles what comes after: hosting, your own domain, search and AI-search readiness, version history, team editing, and a one-command handover to a developer's terminal. One account, one plan, from development to deployment.

Name: OfficeBats
Tagline: The online AI office suite, eleven apps for one price
Description: OfficeBats is an all-in-one AI-powered workspace to create documents, spreadsheets and presentations, edit PDFs, design websites and graphics, collect e-signatures, manage finances, build forms and handle customer support, all with integrated cloud storage and AI assistance.

Name: Appstronaut
Tagline: Ship, track & reply to your iOS apps from an Android phone
Description: Appstronaut brings App Store Connect to Android. Get alerts when builds finish, reviews land or your app's review status changes. See daily sales trends, edit What's New and keywords, and handle TestFlight. All direct with Apple using your own API key, no server.
